units.source_text: 转瞬之间，秋尽冬来，大堰河畔的邸宅里越发冷落萧条，

en.t: In the blink of an eye, autumn ended and winter came, and the mansion beside the Oi River grew ever lonelier and more desolate,

units.source_text: 明石姬母女寂寞无聊，空度岁月。

en.t: while Lady Akashi and her daughter passed the days in loneliness and boredom.

units.source_text: 源氏公子劝道：“在这里到底过不下去，不如迁居到我近旁来吧。”

en.t: Prince Genji urged her, saying, "You cannot go on living here after all. Why not move somewhere near me?"

units.source_text: 但明石姬想：“迁居到那边去，生怕‘轲多苦辛’。

en.t: But Lady Akashi thought, "If I move there, I fear it will bring many hardships.

units.source_text: 若在那边彻底看透了他那薄情的心，我就会大失所望，这时真所谓‘再来哭诉有何言’了。”

en.t: If I come to see his cold heart clearly there, I will be bitterly disappointed, and then I truly will have no words left even if I come back weeping to complain."

units.source_text: 因此踌躇不决。

en.t: For that reason she hesitated and could not decide.

units.source_text: 源氏公子便和她婉言商量：“既然如此，这孩子长住在此终非善策。

en.t: Prince Genji then spoke with her gently and said, "In that case, it is still not wise for this child to live here for long.

units.source_text: 我正在安排她的前程，如果任她埋没在此，岂不委屈了她？

en.t: I am making arrangements for her future, and if we let her remain hidden away here, would that not be unfair to her?

units.source_text: 那边紫夫人早已闻知你有这孩子，常想看看她。

en.t: Lady Murasaki over there has long heard that you have this child and often wishes to see her.

units.source_text: 让她暂时到那边去，和紫夫人熟了些，我想公开地替她举行隆重的穿裙仪式。”

en.t: Let her go there for a while, and once she has grown familiar with Lady Murasaki, I would like to hold a splendid public skirt ceremony for her."

units.source_text: 明石姬早已担心公子作此打算，如今闻言，更觉痛心，答道：“她虽然变成了贵人的女儿，身份抬高了，

en.t: Lady Akashi had already feared that the prince was planning this, and now that she heard him say it, she felt even more pained and answered, "Even if she becomes the daughter of a noble lady and her status rises,

units.source_text: 但倘知道实情的人把风声泄露出去，这事情反而不妙。”

en.t: if someone who knows the truth lets the rumor slip out, the matter will turn out badly instead."

units.source_text: 她总不肯放手。

en.t: She still would not let the child go.

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“你这话也说得有理。

en.t: Prince Genji said, "What you say is reasonable too.

units.source_text: 但紫夫人这边的事，你尽可放心。

en.t: But as for Lady Murasaki, you may be entirely at ease.

units.source_text: 她出嫁多年，不曾生过一男半女，常叹身边寂寞。

en.t: She has been married for many years and has never had a son or daughter, and she often laments the loneliness around her.

units.source_text: 她生性喜欢孩子。

en.t: By nature she loves children.

units.source_text: 像前斋宫那样年纪很大的女孩，她也强要当作女儿疼爱她。

en.t: Even a grown girl like the former high priestess she insists on cherishing as though she were her own daughter.

units.source_text: 何况你这个无疵无瑕的小宝贝，她岂肯轻易舍弃？”

en.t: How, then, could she possibly cast aside lightly this flawless little treasure of yours?"

units.source_text: 便向她叙述紫姬的品性如何善良。

en.t: He then described to her how kind and good Lady Murasaki's character was.

units.source_text: 明石姬听了，想道：“以前约略听到世人传说：这源氏公子东钻西营，拈花惹草，不知要遇到怎样的人才能安定。

en.t: When Lady Akashi heard this, she thought, "I once heard people say vaguely that Prince Genji was always seeking and pursuing women, and that no one knew what kind of person could ever make him settle down.

units.source_text: 原来其人就是这紫姬，他已经死心塌地地奉她为正夫人了，可见他们的宿缘不浅。

en.t: So that person was this Lady Murasaki; he has devoted himself to her wholeheartedly as his principal wife, which shows that their bond from former lives is deep.

units.source_text: 而这位夫人的品性比别人更加优越，也可想而知了。

en.t: It is easy to imagine, then, that this lady's character is superior to that of others.

units.source_text: 像我这样微不足数的人，当然不能和她并肩争宠。

en.t: Someone as insignificant as I am naturally cannot stand beside her and compete for his favor.

units.source_text: 如果贸然迁居东院，参与其列，岂不被她耻笑？

en.t: If I rashly move to the East Wing and join their ranks, would she not laugh at me?

units.source_text: 我身利害，且不计较，倒是这孩子来日方长，恐怕将来终须靠她照拂。

en.t: I need not consider my own advantage or harm for now, but this child has a long future ahead of her, and in the end she may have to rely on that lady's care.

units.source_text: 如此说来，还不如趁这无知无识的童稚之年把她让给了她吧。”

en.t: In that case, it may be better to give her over to Lady Murasaki while she is still too young to understand anything."

units.source_text: 既而又想：“倘若这孩子离开了我，我不知要怎样挂念她。

en.t: Then she thought again, "If this child leaves me, I do not know how deeply I will long for her.

units.source_text: 而且寂寞无聊之时无以慰情，教我如何度日？

en.t: And when I am lonely and bored with nothing to comfort my heart, how am I to pass the days?

units.source_text: 这孩子一去，更有何物可以引逗公子偶尔降临呢？”

en.t: Once this child is gone, what else will draw the prince to visit me now and then?"

units.source_text: 她左思右想，方寸迷乱，但觉此身忧患无穷。

en.t: She turned the matter over and over in her mind until her heart was in turmoil, feeling only that her life was filled with endless sorrow and trouble.
